-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Use 0 for no after-context. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Use 0 for no before-context. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-C.description: Alias for context. Use 0 when not needed.

-i.description: Case insensitive search (rg -i). Use false for the default behavior.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Use true for the default behavior. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.go", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob. Use an empty string for no glob filter.

path.description: Absolute file or directory path to search in (rg PATH). Use an empty string for the tool's configured working directory.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. Use an empty string for all file types.

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Use 0 for the default behavior.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Use 0 for no context. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Use false for the default behavior.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes. Use 250 for the default behavior. Pass 0 for unlimited.

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines, "files_with_matches" shows file paths, "count" shows match counts. Use "files_with_matches" for the default behavior.
